name: mrye-web-site
description: Mr Ye 幸福食光: one-page restaurant site with a real-time 3D bubble tea builder (Three.js r159, no framework, no bundler)

scripts.test: node build.mjs && node build.mjs --debug && python3 tests/run_all.py
scripts.test:fast: node build.mjs && node build.mjs --debug && python3 tests/run_all.py --fast
scripts.check:dist: node build.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- dist/index.html dist/lab.html dist/bubbletea-3d.js
